resources.string: Live - your voice is being changed

How to use:
1. Turn on and pair your Bluetooth speaker / stereo and any mic first.
2. Tap Refresh so the devices show up in the lists.
3. Pick the output (the speaker the changed voice comes out of).
4. Tap Start, allow the microphone permission, then talk.

It keeps running in the background and stops only when you fully close the app.
Changing your voice in the background
Keeps the voice changer running in the background
Microphone permission is required to change your voice.
